title: Meal-Status Waiver, Household Cap and Early-Return Credit Rates for the Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program
content:
Business office rate table for the Fine Arts Instrument Usage Program. It states, per usage type, the share of the usage fee waived for a student holding a Free Meal Status or Reduced-Price Meal Status tier, the household's yearly ceiling on usage fees, and the early-return credit.

## Rates by usage type

| Usage type | Share of the usage fee waived for any Free Meal Status tier | Share of the usage fee waived for any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier | Maximum usage fees per household per school year after waivers (USD) | Calendar days after checkout within which a returned instrument credits the usage fee (checkout date is day 0) | Share of the usage fee net of waivers credited for a return inside that window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Percussion Equipment Usage | 100% | 50% | 200.00 | 14 | 100% |
| Woodwind Instrument Usage | 100% | 50% | 200.00 | 14 | 100% |
| Brass Instrument Usage | 100% | 50% | 200.00 | 14 | 100% |
| Orchestra String Instrument Usage | 100% | 50% | 200.00 | 14 | 100% |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass) | 100% | 50% | 200.00 | 14 | 100% |
| Summer Instrument Checkout | 100% | 50% | 200.00 | 14 | 0% |

## Notes to the table

- The waiver shares are the same under all six usage types: the whole usage fee for any Free Meal Status tier, half of it for any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier.
- The household ceiling of 200.00 is a ceiling on usage fees after waivers for one household in one school year; it is the same figure under every usage type.
- The early-return window is 14 calendar days under every usage type, counting the checkout date as day 0, so day 14 is the last day inside the window. The credit for a return inside the window is 100% of the usage fee net of waivers under the five school-year usage types and 0% under Summer Instrument Checkout.

## Hypothetical figures read from the table

The following are illustrative inputs only, not any household's account:

| Usage type and meal status | Usage fee before waiver | Waived | Net usage fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Woodwind Instrument Usage, Free Meal Status tier | 100.00 | 100.00 | 0.00 |
| Large Instrument Usage (Tuba, Cello, String Bass), Reduced-Price Meal Status tier | 125.00 | 62.50 | 62.50 |
| Percussion Equipment Usage, Reduced-Price Meal Status tier, mid-year checkout at 25.00 | 25.00 | 12.50 | 12.50 |

A Summer Instrument Checkout returned on day 3 earns no early-return credit, because its credit share is 0%; a Brass Instrument Usage checkout returned on day 3 is credited the whole of its usage fee net of waivers.
